name: Tubekeep — sort your YouTube Watch Later, organize subscriptions
description: Search it all, sort by length, date added or channel, clear it in batches. Playlists, subscriptions and deleted videos. All local.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://i.ytimg.com https://yt3.ggpht.com https://*.googleusercontent.com; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://deftfoundry.com https://www.youtube.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src https://deftfoundry.com
